jobs.description:
**Are you ready to take ownership of financial planning and performance management in a global MedTech company?

**Do you thrive at the intersection of finance, strategy, and business partnering? Are you able to translate complex financial data into clear insights and recommendations for senior management? And do you enjoy contributing to projects and initiatives that drive business performance and improve financial processes?

Then you could be Ambu's next Senior FP&A Business Partner.

**Key Responsibilities

**As a Senior FP&A Business Partner, you will join the FP&A team within Business Finance & Analytics, covering FP&A, Commercial Finance, Strategic Finance, Operational Finance, and BI & Data Science. Reporting to the Senior FP&A Manager, you will play an important role in shaping Ambu’s financial planning and performance management processes while contributing to executive decision-making across the organization.

In this highly visible role, you will work closely with stakeholders across Finance, Commercial, Operations, and Executive Management. You will own key planning activities, drive performance insights, and support cross-functional initiatives that contribute to Ambu's continued growth and transformation. The role offers a unique opportunity to combine financial expertise and business partnering in an international environment with exposure to senior leadership and strategic priorities.

This position provides an excellent platform for further development within Business and Strategic Finance.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Owning key elements of the annual financial planning cycle, including budgeting, forecasting, and target setting.

• Driving parts of cross-functional planning and performance management processes in close collaboration with Finance, Commercial, Operations, and functional leadership teams.

• Analyzing business performance and providing actionable insights, recommendations, and decision support to senior management.

• Preparing and presenting financial analyses and performance updates for Executive Management while driving management and Board reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate, and consistent delivery.

• Identifying and implementing improvements to FP&A processes, reporting, and performance management, leveraging digital solutions and AI tools such as Copilot.

• Supporting strategic and transformational initiatives, including finance transformation, process optimization, performance improvement programs, data-driven decision support, and selected activities related to Ambu's multi-year ERP transformation.

**Suggested candidate profile

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are, however, likely to succeed in this position if you combine strong financial expertise with a genuine interest in understanding the business behind the numbers.

You Likely Bring Experience From FP&A, Corporate Finance, Business Finance, Management Consulting, Or a Similar Environment Where You Have Supported Decision-making Through Financial Planning, Performance Management, And Business Partnering. Additionally, You

• Hold a Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Have 6-8 years of experience driving budgeting, forecasting, and performance management processes in complex organizations.

• Have experience working in a global organization where commercial, operational, and financial performance are closely interconnected and require cross-functional planning and performance management.

• Are comfortable working closely with senior stakeholders and preparing analyses and presentations for Executive Leadership Teams and/or Boards of Directors.

• Have experience driving projects or workstreams involving multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

• Build trust and credibility through strong communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling you to navigate effectively across functions and organizational levels.

• Are analytical, structured, and proactive, with advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills. Experience with Power BI, Copilot, or other AI-enabled finance tools is considered an advantage.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Location: Copenhagen or Århus.

Are you interested about customers and future proof design? Then look here!

We are hiring an IP MPLS Specialist for our IP Transport network team. You will play a key role in defining network strategies, driving technical designs, and ensuring seamless execution. Work alongside a team of top experts and help create scalable, secure, and future-proof solutions that position Norlys at the forefront of the Telco industry in Denmark.

Plan, design, and build today for tomorrow’s network

Norlys Transport team is part of Telco Architecture & Planning. Our ambition is to plan, design, and build a network today that caters for tomorrow’s needs.

The Transport team consists of eight highly skilled IP/MPLS, sync, and optical transport network engineers with a strong team spirit. We are responsible for defining and ensuring a cost-efficient, resilient, and future-proof network architecture with clear roadmaps, network rules, and lifecycle management. We handle vendors and evaluate and select systems and partners for all transport platforms.

Your main responsibilities will be to

• Handle end-to-end network connectivity deliveries between internal and external platforms such as mobile core and probing systems.

• Define IP/MPLS network rules and design.

• Manage firewalls and probing equipment.

• Lead lifecycle management.

• Ensure automation of service development.

Your profile includes

• Experience from working with IP MPLS design and lifecycle management.

• Solid understanding of routing protocols and redundant setups.

• Knowledge of test management and CPE/service validation.

• Preferably CCNP certification.

Requirements

• Ability to obtain a Danish Security Clearance.

• Ability to work from our Norlys office in Århus or Copenhagen several days per week.

• Fluent in English, written and spoken. Danish is an advantage.

Join us!

If you have questions, you can contact Senior Manager of Architecture, Development & Design, Henriette Pedersen at 28 27 08 48 or hpeder@norlys.dk. Please send us your application and CV through our online recruitment system as soon as possible. You decide whether your application and CV should be in English or Danish, we do not differentiate.

Norlys is Denmark’s largest integrated energy and telecommunications group with approx. 800,000 co-op shareholders, 3.5 million customer relations, 4,600 employees and over 100 years of history. As a co-operative, taking responsibility for more than just ourselves is embedded in our DNA. That’s why we don’t just deliver future-proof solutions to Danish homes and companies. We also work consciously towards a green and digital transformation for all of society. And that is why we are passionate about creating progress for people, the local environment and the climate.

We hope you enjoy the experience. Because we believe that the future is as good as we make it. Together.

Digital Transformation Lead

Workplace technology shapes the daily experience of everyone who works at Danske Bank. As Digital Transformation Lead, you will connect business needs, technology decisions, and operational realities to help build a workplace that works well for all employees and teams. This is a role where strategic thinking and practical detail go hand in hand.

What you will be doing

You will join a diverse team of seven people within the Center of Excellence in Group Workplace Management, collectively responsible for workplace management strategy, the digital roadmap, workplace insights, and performance management. The team works across a broad stakeholder landscape that includes employees across Danske Bank, external technology suppliers, facility management vendors, application owners, and operational teams. Collaboration, knowledge sharing, and a practical approach to improvement are central to how the team operates. More specifically, you will:

• Develop and maintain the workplace technology landscape and digital implementation roadmap

• Act as business-side owner for solutions covering meeting management, visitor management, smart storage, and hospitality

• Prepare recommendations to invest in, retain, standardise, consolidate, replace, or decommission technologies

• Identify technology-related compliance gaps and coordinate the necessary business input to address them

• Provide business-side input to technology budgets, licensing requirements, hardware needs, and supplier discussions

• Develop user guides, administrator guides, intranet content, and operational handover material

• Facilitate workshops, define business processes and user journeys, and support testing and implementation

About you

• Experience translating business and operational needs into clear requirements

• Ability to combine strategic thinking with structured coordination and follow-up

• Experience working with technology portfolios, digital solutions, or implementation roadmaps

• Comfortable facilitating workshops and aligning stakeholders with varying priorities

• Strong analytical and organisational skills with the ability to bring clarity to complex topics

• Builds trusted relationships and works effectively across teams, functions, and countries

A background in business analysis, technology portfolio management, product ownership, or digital workplace solutions would be advantageous. We value varied experience and welcome candidates who bring a different perspective to this work.

What we offer you

This role gives you direct involvement in shaping the workplace experience for employees, visitors, and operational teams across Danske Bank. You will work in a hybrid setup, typically spending three to four days per week in the office, enabling close collaboration and knowledge sharing with your team. There is genuine scope for learning across both strategic and operational dimensions of workplace technology.

Are you ready for the next step?

If you would like to learn more about this position, please reach out to Andrea Toft, Head of Center of Excellence, Group Workplace Management, at anto@danskebank.dk. Please submit your application by 6 November 2026.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**WHY SPEKTR

**At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

_Compliance, built like product.

_Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

• $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

• Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

• Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**We’re looking for a QA Automation Engineer to help us build and scale high-quality, reliable products as we grow.

You’ll work closely with backend engineers, product managers, and customer-facing teams to build and maintain the automated testing that keeps our platform behaving exactly as intended, especially across complex, AI-driven, API-first systems. If you enjoy writing solid test code, finding the edge cases others miss, and helping teams ship with confidence, you’ll feel at home here.

**What You Will Be Doing

**

• Test Automation: Design, build and maintain scalable automated E2E test suites using Playwright, using LLMs to speed up test generation and maintenance.

• Agent Validation: Build and run test cases and evals that validate AI agent behaviour, so our autonomous compliance workflows are accurate, explainable and hallucination-free.

• API & Data Validation: Test RESTful APIs and validate complex data flows, checking data directly in the database so frontend, backend and AI systems stay fully aligned.

• CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so AI model updates and deployments don’t break existing logic.

• Production Issues: Investigate production issues, reproduce failures and turn them into automated regression tests.

• Quality Practices: Work with engineers and PMs early in development on testability and acceptance criteria, and contribute to our QA processes and standards.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• The Scale-up Mindset: You thrive in fast-moving environments and prefer building systems over following manuals.

• Automation Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frameworks like Playwright.

• API & Database Skills: You’re comfortable navigating backend services, testing RESTful APIs and verifying data integrity with SQL.

• Maintainable Test Code: You don’t just write scripts. You write clean, reusable tests that the rest of the team can build on.

• Communication Skills: You can explain a bug or edge case clearly to both a PM and an engineer.

• Detail Obsession: You have a “sixth sense” for where a system might break and a genuine passion for delivering a polished user experience.

• Curiosity about AI testing: Exposure to testing LLM-based features or eval frameworks is a strong plus.

**OUR TECH INTERESTS

**

• Languages: JavaScript / TypeScript

• Testing: Playwright

• AI/ML: LLM Prompting, LangChain/AutoGPT concepts, Evals frameworks

• Infrastructure: API-driven architectures, SQL databases, CI/CD pipelines

**OUR PROCESS

**

• Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (60 minutes)

**How To Apply

**We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

spektr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic, and we assess every candidate against the same role requirements.

Are you the kind of person who notices when something could be better, and has the drive to make it happen? At DISA, quality is not just a checkpoint at the end of the process. It is built into the way we design, source, produce and deliver world-class foundry machines. We are looking for a Quality Engineer who wants to be close to the product, close to production and close to the decisions that improve how we work.

This role is for someone who enjoys solving real quality challenges in a manufacturing environment. Someone who is structured, curious and persistent enough to follow an issue from first observation to sustainable improvement.

What You’ll Do

• Take ownership of quality improvements across supplier quality, production quality and internal quality processes.

• Handle non-conformities, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and ensure follow-up until issues are properly closed.

• Work closely with production, engineering, procurement and suppliers to identify risks, solve quality challenges and prevent repeat issues.

• Support and develop supplier quality performance through audits, structured follow-up, documentation and improvement plans.

• Use data, facts and structured problem-solving tools to analyze trends, set priorities and recommend practical quality improvements.

• Contribute to audits, customer requirements and management systems, with ISO 14001 as an area where you have basic knowledge or interest.

Why You’ll Love Working with Us

• A role where quality is at the center — not a side responsibility.

• The chance to work hands-on with complex, high-precision equipment and see the impact of your improvements in real production.

• A workplace where your structure, curiosity and follow-through help prevent issues before they reach the customer.

• Close collaboration with production, engineering, procurement and suppliers, so you can turn observations into practical improvements.

• The opportunity to help strengthen quality culture in a global industrial company with strong products, proud craftsmanship and long product lifetimes.

You will not be sitting far away from the product or the people making it. You will be part of the daily dialogue around quality, helping colleagues and suppliers understand what went wrong, why it happened and how we make sure it does not happen again.

Who You Are

• You have a background in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Production Technology or a similar field.

• You have experience with quality work in a manufacturing, production or industrial environment.

• You are motivated by root cause analysis, corrective actions and the satisfaction of closing issues properly.

• You understand supplier quality or are eager to work closely with suppliers on deviations, audits, documentation and improvement plans.

• You like being close to the shop floor and working with people across functions to solve practical quality challenges.

• You are analytical and structured, but also pragmatic enough to find solutions that work in real life.

• You follow through — because you know that quality improvements only matter when they are actually implemented and sustained.

• You have knowledge of ISO 14001 or an interest in building a basic understanding of environmental management systems.

If you are driven by quality, manufacturing and continuous improvement, and if you enjoy turning problems into clear actions and better ways of working, we would like to hear from you. You do not need to tick every box; what matters most is your quality mindset, your curiosity and your ability to follow through.

About Norican

NORICAN. Metal. Made. Possible.

We are Norican, a global industrial group designing, building and supporting best‑in‑class machines and technologies for metal formation and surface treatment.

Bringing together five leading brands - DISA, Simpson, StrikoWestofen, Wheelabrator and Monitizer – we deliver one connected solution across the production process, supported by full‑service expertise and digital solutions.

Across green sand molding, die casting, sand preparation, melting, transport and dosing, and surface treatment, we help manufacturers improve performance and transform production across a wide range of industries. We build lifetime quality and long‑term partnerships by combining the strengths of our legacy brands to lead the industry through innovation, sustainability and profitable growth.

DISA:

DISA design, build and support premium green sand moulding and cashing machines for the ferrous and non-ferrous foundry industries. For 125 years they have delivered machines that last for decades, and they are highly respected by customers and peers for excellent levels of quality and service. DISA machines keep customers producing relentlessly to the very highest standards. And they empower foundry productivity with a lifetime of efficient and a lower cost per casting.

Want to know more? Ready to apply?

We will review candidates continuously, so please send your application as soon as possible. If you have any questions about the role, please contact Johnny Rasmussen at johnny.rasmussen@norican.com.

jobs.occupation: Specialist - Energy, Indoor Climate and Daylight
jobs.description:
Do you want to contribute to create healthy, energy-efficient, and sustainable buildings? Do you have experience in indoor climate design and energy optimization for complex building projects? Perhaps you have just a few years of experience or perhaps you are a senior specialist - the important thing is that you are motivated to apply your expertise and curiosity to develop solutions that enable a better tomorrow.

Turn challenges into sustainable solutions

At COWI, we help our clients create attractive, comfortable, and sustainable buildings through energy optimization, indoor climate design, and daylight analysis. To grow our team, we are looking for a Specialist in Energy, Indoor Climate and Daylight to join our growing group of approximately 30 colleagues. Together, we work on exciting and complex projects across the building, industrial, pharmaceutical, and transformation sectors.

In this position, you will become part of an established, highly collaborative professional environment across COWI and Arkitema. We deliver energy calculations, indoor climate simulations, daylight analyses, and sustainability advisory services.

You will work closely with experts across multiple disciplines on both new-build projects and the transformation of existing buildings. Our interdisciplinary collaboration is one of our greatest advantages, enabling us to continuously raise the bar for sustainability across the industry

Your key activities will be:

• Contribute to the design and optimization of energy-efficient, healthy, and sustainable buildings for both new construction and renovation projects.

• Carry out energy, indoor climate, and daylight simulations and analyses using tools such as IES VE, Rhino/Grasshopper, and similar software.

• Collaborate closely with architects, engineers, sustainability specialists, and clients to develop integrated design solutions.

• Support project managers and discipline leads in delivering high-quality technical solutions.

• Participate in technical development and knowledge sharing within the team.

• Contribute to innovation and the continuous improvement of our methods, tools, and services.

• Depending on your experience, take responsibility for smaller assignments or specific technical work packages within larger projects.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. You should also be open to new perspectives and continuously seek opportunities to learn, innovate, and improve.

On top of that, you will:

• Have at least three years of experience in indoor climate simulations, building performance analysis, and/or energy optimization within construction, building operations, or industry.

• Have experience working on projects in Denmark and be familiar with Danish building regulations.

• Be comfortable managing your own tasks while making a contribution to multidisciplinary project teams.

• Have professional proficiency in at least one Scandinavian language, both written and spoken.

• Take a collaborative and professional approach to working with colleagues, clients, and business partners.

• Demonstrate high integrity and a willingness to share knowledge and support the professional development of others.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to build a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and most importantly our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. That is why we say no to fossil-based projects and aspire to have most of our revenue come from activities that move our customers towards sustainability.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America and India, we are currently 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve, and what life is like at COWI.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

jobs.occupation: Technical Lead - Substation Automation and Communication Systems
jobs.description:
Do you have experience with automation and communication systems for high-voltage substations? Can you lead technical work packages and coordinate specialist contributions to deliver an integrated solution? Join COWI as our new Technical Lead and contribute to the development of Denmark’s electricity transmission infrastructure.

Take technical responsibility for substation automation projects

We are looking for an experienced engineer to take technical responsibility for substation automation and communication systems in high-voltage substation projects. You will work on projects ranging from new substations to extensions, refurbishment and replacement of systems at existing sites. You will coordinate specialist contributions, manage technical interfaces and ensure that individual work packages meet the requirements of the overall substation automation solution.

The role combines technical expertise with responsibility for coordinating engineering activities, monitoring progress and ensuring the quality of technical deliverables. You will work closely with the project manager, technical specialists and other engineering disciplines throughout project execution.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Lead and coordinate the technical delivery of substation automation and communication systems.

• Plan and follow up on engineering activities, technical deliverables and milestones within your scope.

• Coordinate specialist contributions and ensure consistency across technical work packages.

• Ensure that technical solutions and documentation comply with project requirements, customer specifications and applicable standards.

• Manage technical interfaces between automation, communication systems, protection systems, primary equipment and auxiliary systems.

• Identify and resolve technical issues in collaboration with specialists and other engineering disciplines.

• Participate in project meetings and advise the project manager on technical matters, dependencies and risks within your area of responsibility.

• Coordinate technical activities with customers, suppliers and other project stakeholders.

Your expertise

You combine a strong technical foundation with a structured approach to planning and coordination. You can assess how individual systems and specialist contributions fit together, communicate technical requirements clearly and follow through on agreed actions.

You work independently and build effective working relationships with colleagues, customers and project partners.

You will also bring:

• A degree in electrical engineering or an equivalent technical qualification, together with more than five years of relevant experience in automation for high-voltage substations.

• A solid understanding of substation automation systems, including control and monitoring functions, communication networks and interfaces to protection equipment.

• An understanding of how substation secondary systems interface with high-voltage primary equipment.

• Experience coordinating technical work packages, planning engineering activities and following up on specialist deliverables.

• The ability to assess technical solutions, manage interfaces and maintain an overview of quality, progress and dependencies.

• Professional proficiency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• The ability to obtain the required security clearance and fulfil the requirements for the designated on-site role of “holdleder” at high-voltage substations.

Your place of work

Depending on project requirements, you may work from one of COWI’s offices in Denmark, at Energinet project locations or partly from home. Travel within Denmark is expected.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Head of Discipline Carsten Sass Husum at CSHU@COWI.COM.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Equal opportunity employer

COWI provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, COWI complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Lead the delivery. Build client trust. Shape the energy transition.

Do you combine strong construction management skills with a commercial mindset and a passion for delivering complex infrastructure projects? Do you know how to turn plans into successful project execution while creating value for clients, partners, and the business?

At COWI, we are looking for a Senior Construction Manager in District Heating to join our team of 20 dedicated professionals in Lyngby. In this role you will report to Malik Basoda, Head of Discipline Energy Plants and Infrastructure. Furthermore, you will play a key part in delivering district heating projects that support the green transition while strengthening our position as a trusted partner in the energy market.

Turn project expertise into business value

As Senior Construction Manager you will take ownership of construction management across district heating projects, ensuring that solutions are delivered safely, efficiently, and to the highest standards of quality.

You will work closely with clients, contractors, consultants, and colleagues to create successful project outcomes — balancing technical excellence with commercial performance and client satisfaction.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Leading construction management activities for district heating projects, from planning and tendering through execution and handover.

• Building strong client relationships and identifying opportunities to create additional value.

• Managing contractors, site activities, schedules, budgets, risks, quality, and health and safety.

• Supporting tender preparation, estimating, contract management, and commercial negotiations.

• Identifying new business opportunities and contributing to the growth of COWI’s district heating portfolio.

• Coordinating multidisciplinary teams and ensuring effective collaboration across projects.

• Sharing your experience and mentoring colleagues to strengthen the team's capabilities.

Your skills. Your commercial mindset. Our shared ambition.

We are looking for a senior professional who understands that successful construction management is about more than delivering on time and on budget. It is about understanding the client’s needs, anticipating challenges, managing risk, and creating lasting value.

On top of that you bring:

• Significant experience in construction management, preferably within district heating, energy infrastructure, utilities, or other complex civil engineering projects.

• Strong knowledge of construction methods, contractor management, planning, cost control, and contract administration.

• A commercial and market-oriented mindset, with the ability to understand client priorities and translate them into business opportunities.

• Proven leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to make decisions and drive progress.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work across disciplines and organisations.

• A relevant technical education or equivalent practical experience.

• Professional proficiency in Danish and English, appropriate to the projects and clients you will support.

A place to work and so much more.

Before you apply

As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting up teams and fora. Create Solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

Are you motivated by working with complex commercial contracts, legal risk management and major construction and infrastructure projects in an international environment? Do you enjoy combining strong legal expertise with a pragmatic, business-oriented approach to support decision-making and deliver practical solutions? And do you thrive in a collaborative role where you can build relationships across a global organization? Then COWI could be the right place for you.

To support our business in Denmark and internationally, we are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel to join our legal team at COWI's headquarters in Lyngby, Denmark. As an international consultancy, COWI delivers engineering, architecture, energy and environmental solutions across the globe. We contribute to some of the world's most significant and sustainable projects, and our legal team plays an important role in enabling our business, managing legal and commercial risks, and supporting successful project delivery.

In this role, you will report to the Head of Legal responsible for Business Line Denmark. You will join the Danish legal team, consisting of four senior legal counsels and two paralegals, and become part of COWI's Group Legal function. Group Legal comprises 25 team members based in Denmark, Sweden, Norway, the UK, Ireland and Canada, providing comprehensive legal support across COWI's business lines.

This position is ideal for an experienced legal professional who enjoys working hands-on with complex contractual matters, negotiating commercial agreements and supporting large construction and infrastructure projects. You will take ownership of legal matters, provide clear and commercially focused advice, and work closely with colleagues across the organization to manage risk and find practical solutions.

Your key responsibilities

• Providing day-to-day legal advice and assistance to senior management, operational management and project managers in Denmark and internationally.

• Structuring, drafting and negotiating consultancy agreements, framework agreements, joint venture agreements, memoranda of understanding, teaming agreements and other commercial contracts.

• Advising on contract management, claims management and the identification, assessment and mitigation of legal and commercial risks.

• Reviewing and negotiating contracts for large and complex construction and infrastructure projects, including agreements based on ABR 18, AB 18, FIDIC and bespoke contractual terms.

• Providing legal support to ongoing projects throughout their lifecycle, helping project teams navigate contractual obligations, risks and commercial challenges.

• Advising on disputes and settlement negotiations, including instructing and coordinating external legal counsel.

• Supporting, training and guiding line managers and senior management on legal matters, including contracts, public procurement, competition law, intellectual property rights and data protection.

• Supporting corporate housekeeping and advising on legal compliance matters.

• Providing legal support for mergers and acquisitions and other strategic business initiatives.

• Contributing to the continuous improvement and development of COWI's standard contract templates and legal processes.

Your skills. Our teams. Together we design the future.

At COWI, collaboration is essential. We value professionals who build strong relationships, take ownership, and contribute with both technical expertise and a pragmatic, business-oriented mindset. You are proactive, curious and motivated to continuously improve how legal support is delivered across the organization.

On top of that, you will have:

• A Danish Master's degree in Law.

• Experience from a law firm and/or an in-house legal function.

• Extensive experience in contractual review and negotiation, including ABR 18, AB 18, FIDIC and bespoke forms of agreements.

• A strong understanding of legal and commercial risk management, with the ability to identify, assess and mitigate contractual risks.

• Strong drafting and communication skills in both Danish and English.

• Excellent analytical skills and the ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, concise and commercially relevant advice for legal and non-legal stakeholders.

• A pragmatic, business-oriented approach, balancing attention to detail with an understanding of the bigger picture.

• The ability to work independently, take ownership of complex legal matters and make sound, well-reasoned decisions.

• A collaborative mindset and an interest in working as part of a specialist legal team supporting a large international organization.

• Experience working in an international environment would be an advantage.

A place to work and so much more.

At COWI, we collaborate with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow.

We support our customers' transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to set a positive standard by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the solutions we provide for our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun, because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home. With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America and India, we bring together expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and the environment to create lasting impact.

Got More Questions?

If you have any questions about the role or what we have to offer, please contact Head of Legal Denmark, Kit Bækgaard at kich@cowi.com or Senior Global Talent Acquisition Specialist, Mette Gutte at mtgt@cowi.com

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you're interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths.

We take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting up teams and forums. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

We’re looking for an experienced Customer Success Manager, to manage, assist and consult our customers on the DACH market and ensure a strong long term relationship. You will handle customer cycles from onboarding to renewal, and be able to have a clear impact on how we manage our customers now and going forward.

This role can be based in our Copenhagen HQ or in Hamburg.

**About Pandektes

**Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

**About The Role

**You will join our current team of three in Customer Success to work on serving our German-speaking customers. As an early member of the team, you will be able to have an instant impact on the customer experience.

This is a full-cycle CSM position, which means you will handle everything from onboarding to renewal. This means we’re looking for someone who is passionate about strong customer relations, but ideally also with a knack for teaching. When it comes to contracts and numbers, you’ll be working closely with our account executives to ensure we find the best fit for our customers.

As the team is young, we hope that you will also want to be a part of shaping the processes and future of CS at Pandektes.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Onboarding customers - Teach lawyers and legal professionals how AI can superpower their legal research

• Drive adoption - Collaborate with management/executives to ensure adoption and success

• Build community - Find superusers and empower them to do even more with Pandektes

• Foster growth - Identify expansion opportunities and work with the rest of our team to expand our presence at existing customers

**What You’ll Bring

**

• Fluency in German and English

• Entrepreneurial mindset, motivated by creating good relationships, top-notch customer experience and driving growth as part of our commercial team

• Experience with Customer Success in a SaaS B2B company and/or a legal background

• Excellent communication skills and strong ability to build trust – we value long-term customer relationships

• Eagerness to learn and openness to feedback; you value insights from others and use them to grow

• Proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively

• Strong interest in technology and enthusiasm for AI (basic knowledge of AI and LLMs is a plus)

• Willingness to develop deep knowledge of how lawyers work and conduct legal research (a legal background is an advantage but not required)

**How We Work

**We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value ownership – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in Copenhagen, Hamburg, London and Zurich.

**What we offer

**

• Competitive compensation + commission

• An attractive warrant program

• A collaborative work environment where your input is not only valued but often implemented within hours

• 25 vacation days per year + public holidays

• International team events – last time we went to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you join us next time

• Paid parental leave

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

Our operations team is looking for a Finance Manager who is tired of the status quo. You will work closely with our software engineers and operations team to help shape the future of finance in property management.

To be quite frank: if you currently work with bookkeeping in property management, you probably know the pain. Too much manual work, outdated systems, endless reconciliations, and processes built around software from another decade.

We want to change that. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to rethink and shape how bookkeeping and accounting workflows should work for our customers' property portfolio.

Right now is the best time to join because you’ll help define both the role and the systems behind it as we scale across the Nordics.

****What we do

****Property management is fundamentally broken. It’s held back by legacy software and linear scaling: more tenants equals more manual work.

We automate high-volume, low-value tasks like bank reconciliation, debt collection, and financial administration to remove unnecessary friction and human error from the rental experience.

Rumli is a seal of quality and trust in a messy market. After years of scaling our software to thousands of users, we are now rebuilding our entire stack from the ground up with AI as the foundation. We are moving from being a software provider to a full-service property manager.

We’re not just building the platform; we’re running it.

****You will

• Be a core part of the team: Work closely with operations and product to improve financial workflows and internal systems.

• Handle day-to-day bookkeeping: ensure our automations work as intended across reconciliation, vendor invoice management, payroll and financial administration for the properties we manage.

• Ensure financial accuracy: Manage balance sheet reconciliations, payments, VAT handling, and monthly, quarterly and yearly accounts.

• Help improve the system: Identify repetitive or inefficient workflows and help the product team decide what to automate next.

• Operate at scale: Use modern tools and automation to manage a portfolio size that would be difficult in a traditional setup.

• Support the business: Assist with designing the reporting, budgeting, on- and offboarding of new properties, and ad hoc finance tasks as we continue to grow.

****You may be a fit if you are

• From the field: You have experience with bookkeeping, accounting, or financial administration – ideally within property management or a related industry.

• Done with manual work and outdated processes: You’ve worked with legacy bookkeeping and already have opinions on how finance workflows could be smarter.

• Detail-oriented: You care about accuracy and structure without losing sight of the bigger picture.

• A systems thinker: You enjoy improving processes, not just following them.

• Comfortable with IT systems: You have worked with different software, like e-conomic, before and are quick at adopting new ones.

• Bilingual: You are fluent in Danish and comfortable working in English.

• Equipped with an entrepreneurial mindset: You’re comfortable taking ownership and working in a fast-paced startup environment.

****What you’ll get

****Almost everyone lives or works in a building someone else looks after, and how that is done has barely changed in decades. Rumli is rethinking it – and you'll be part of the team making it happen, backed by some of Denmark's leading investors. The distance from idea to action here is short, and impact gets noticed fast.

• Ownership of the company through our warrant program.

• An office in the heart of Copenhagen.

• Daily lunch, drinks and snacks at the office.

• Private health insurance.

• 30 days of paid holiday.

We're looking for people, not bullet points on a CV. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. If this sounds like you and you want to build something that matters with people who care, we'd love to hear from you.

STUDIO 9 is looking for a commercially driven Sales Manager to turn strong customer interest in KEYSTONE into signed contracts and long-term partnerships.

This role carries clear responsibility for the sales pipeline and the full commercial process, from initial customer dialogue and pilot to negotiation and agreement.

ABOUT KEYSTONE

KEYSTONE is STUDIO 9’s SaaS platform that enables our customers to collect, structure and manage product data directly from their suppliers.

The platform makes it easier for our customers to meet the evolving compliance requirements in areas spanning from EUDR, supply chain traceability, digital product passport (DPP) and LCA. It is built as a SaaS platform that can easily integrate into our customers’ system landscape (e.g. to their ERP and PIM-system).

ABOUT THE ROLE

Working closely with our Sales Director and Software & Implementation team, you will drive KEYSTONE’s commercial growth and help shape how the platform is positioned, sold and delivered.

You will lead the customer journey from the first conversation through agreement, onboarding and long-term development. This includes identifying the right decision-makers, building support across the customer’s organisation and presenting a clear financial and operational case for choosing KEYSTONE.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Drive customer acquisition and commercial growth for KEYSTONE

• Own the sales process from initial dialogue to signed agreement

• Progress opportunities through demonstrations, pilots, negotiations and internal approvals

• Identify decision-makers and build support across the customer’s organisation

• Build compelling ROI cases that demonstrate KEYSTONE’s financial and operational value

• Maintain a structured pipeline with forecasts and clear next steps

• Ensure a smooth transition from sales to implementation

• Support customer adoption, retention and account growth

• Bring customer insights into product positioning and business development, collaborating closely with Sales, Product and Software teams

ABOUT YOU

You are motivated by progressing sales opportunities and turning interest into lasting customer relationships. You work in a structured way, create momentum and follow opportunities through to completion.

You are comfortable exploring a customer’s software landscape, understanding how systems, data and workflows connect, and translating software capabilities into clear business value. You can engage both commercial and IT stakeholders in conversations about business needs, integrations and scalability.

You bring:

• Proven results in B2B sales within SaaS, software or digital solutions, combined with an understanding of enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, PIM and PLM platforms

• The ability to discuss APIs, system integrations and product data flows at a commercial level, connecting technical requirements to customer needs

• Experience managing complex sales cycles from discovery and qualification through solution presentations, proposal development and contract negotiation

• The ability to build a convincing business case around ROI, operational efficiency and data quality

• Strong stakeholder management

• A disciplined approach to CRM, pipeline management and sales forecasting

Experience with product information management (PIM), master data, supply chain processes or compliance is an advantage, as is knowledge of the fashion, furniture and lifestyle industries.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will join KEYSTONE early in its growth journey and play a central role in shaping how the platform is sold and scaled. You will have high ownership, close collaboration across teams, and the opportunity to make a visible impact.

We offer a flexible working environment with our headquarters located by the harbour in Horsens, Denmark. While we value in-person collaboration, we are open to candidates based elsewhere and support remote working arrangements.

READY TO GROW KEYSTONE?

Send your application and CV as soon as possible. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. If you have questions about the role, please contact Sales Director Rasmus Ravnholt: rasmus.ravnholt@nineunited.com. We look forward to hearing from you.

ABOUT STUDIO 9

At STUDIO 9, we work with branding in every detail. We design and develop physical brand experiences for international fashion, jewellery and lifestyle brands – from garment accessories such as labels and hangtags to packaging, shop fixtures, window displays and complete retail environments.

Our work covers the entire process, from the initial idea and design development to compliance, sourcing, production and delivery.

STUDIO 9 is part of the Nine United family, with our headquarters in Horsens and sourcing offices across Europe and Asia. We are a close-knit team with a culture built on collaboration, trust and strong relationships.

Imagine a future where you are a key part of our Asset Integrity Team operating some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets both onshore and offshore

Welcome to Asset Integrity

You’ll be part of Asset Integrity where you, together with your engineering colleague will support the organisation with your mechanical engineering skills in the operation, inspection, engineering, integrity and asset management. As a team we foster collaboration and innovation. We are a group of ambitious professionals within different engineering disciplines, who are passionate and motivated and who value teamwork as an essential part of safeguarding our assets.

You’ll play an important role in:

• executing various engineering studies and tasks for onshore oil&gas terminals and offshore and onshore pipelines both internally and by defining scope of work and liaison with external engineering consultants

• performing inspection data analysis and integrity assessment of our approx 800km of pipelines

• supporting the offshore inspection and maintenance campaigns.

• liaison with Authorities, Contractors, Oil&Gas companies and other third parties.

• act as offshore company representative/supervisor onboard contractors’ vessels

• ensure and perform engineering and quality check and final delivery of inspection results to our Integrity engineers

• providing input to budgets and reporting to management.

Once familiar with our systems, you will be included in a 24/7 duty roster to respond to emergency situations.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have key focus on safety, which shall be embedded in all the work you do;

• hold an engineering degree, preferably in mechanical engineering

• have experience working with oil&gas plant and pipeline integrity and engineering both onshore and offshore

• have experience working with engineering companies, contractors and/or suppliers;

• have experience working with practical onshore and offshore pipeline operation and maintenance as well as experience in marine and subsea operations and inspection methods

• have a proactive and systematic approach to your work tasks

• possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills and can work independently in your area of responsibility and participate in a culture of knowledge sharing in an open, honest and trustful culture

• are a team player who thrives on solving complex problems together with your colleagues.

• speak and write English fluently and knowledge with a Scandinavian language is an advantage.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. You’ll receive the training needed to maintain and further develop your competencies.

The role involves some travel, including two to three day trips per month to onshore sites, a two-week offshore campaign in summer, and a few conferences or courses each year.

Working at Ørsted

In the Asset Integrity department we have the responsibility for looking after some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets. We have highly skilled employees dedicated to safeguard and care for our assets.

We offer a collaborative, dynamic, and diverse workplace with constructive feedback and continuous learning, enabling our people to develop their expertise in asset integrity and engineering.

Shape the future with us

Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

Position salary range:

For this position, the expected base pay range is kr54,480.00- kr68,100.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

Our benefits package:

For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

Pre-employment background check:

This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

A Snapshot of Your Day

As Senior Technical Project Manager you will lead and manage the substation engineering work for onshore substations, offshore wind projects, Power-to-X (PtX) technologies, and energy transmission projects in general. That means you can be involved from the bidding process, all the way through the project execution until the warranty is concluded and the project is handed over on to service.

You will be the Technical Project Manager resource for sales opportunities and for project execution. Therefore, you can simultaneously work in sales opportunities and projects. Besides the sales and project teams, you will have a close collaboration with our Project Management department, procurement function as well as our international business units. By joining us you will become part of a continuously growing team of passionate Technical Project Managers and Engineers.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Coordinate overall single-line diagram for the substations and overall substation layouts together with our 3D team.

• Coordinate all the electrotechnical drawings related to the scope.

• Give input to and plan installation and commissioning phase.

• Coordinate technical input and give support to Procurement team within the selection and onboarding process of suppliers.

• Work proactively in close collaboration with overall project managers as well as other technical project managers and specialists.

• Coordinate the technical procurement of materials for the substation

• Execute thorough QA of suppliers’ projects deliverables.

• Coordinate the civil design input with our civil partners.

What You Bring

• Degree in Electrical Engineering (or equivalent) with 5+ years of experience in high voltage substation design and engineering

• Broad knowledge within subsystems included in the substation in any of the following areas: Air Insulated Switchgear, Gas Insulated Switchgear, Oil filled components, compensation systems, HV and MV cable systems and their terminations, Auxiliary systems, civil works

• Has proven experience in working under rules according to the Danish legislation 1608, as well as experience in the field of a High Voltage substations, either as a “Arbejdsleder” or similar position understanding the practicalities on the site.

• Basic understanding of cyber security in projects.

• Thorough understanding of interfaces and design flow between the sub-systems as well as the capability to break down the design work in appropriate steps for planning purposes.

_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for an AI Business Manager to join our Digital Development team.

**Team

**The AI team is a cross-functional team dedicated to embedding AI directly into CIP's business lifecycles and day-to-day operations across the platform and sits within the wider Digital Development team.

**Role

**The AI Business Manager is responsible for ensuring AI creates measurable business value across CIP's business lifecycles and works directly with lifecycle owners, product teams, delivery teams, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, drive adoption, and embed AI capabilities into day-to-day processes and ways of working.

The AI Business Manager serves as the bridge between business priorities and AI capabilities, ensuring that AI is integrated directly into the Investor, Investment, Fund & Investment Management, and Project lifecycles rather than delivered as standalone technology initiatives. The role is accountable for helping lifecycle teams identify where AI can accelerate outcomes, improve decision-making, increase productivity, and enhance user experiences while ensuring appropriate governance and value realization.

**Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:

**Lifecycle Partnership and Business Engagement

• Partner with lifecycle owners and business stakeholders to understand priorities and strategic objectives, identifying where AI can improve outcomes, efficiency, and decision quality.

• Participate in lifecycle planning and roadmap discussions to embed AI initiatives into business plans from the outset, acting as the primary AI partner for assigned lifecycle domains.

AI Opportunity and Use Case Management

• Facilitate identification, assessment, and prioritization of AI use cases, maintaining the opportunity pipeline based on business value, feasibility, and strategic alignment.

• Develop business cases, value hypotheses, and success metrics, supporting initiatives from ideation and validation through deployment and value realization.

Embedding AI into Business Lifecycles

• Work with business and technology teams to integrate AI into core processes, products, and workflows, redesigning ways of working where relevant and driving adoption of AI-powered tools.

• Support the evolution of lifecycle operating models to treat AI as a native capability, scaling effective patterns across domains.

Governance and Responsible AI

• Ensure AI initiatives comply with governance, security, risk, privacy, and regulatory requirements, coordinating with legal, risk, compliance, and information security stakeholders as needed.

• Support lifecycle teams in navigating AI policies and approval processes, promoting responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight.

Value Realization and Performance Management

• Track KPIs for AI adoption, utilization, and business value, measuring realized benefits such as productivity gains, cost savings, and risk reduction.

• Provide regular updates to leadership on AI portfolio performance and lifecycle impact.

Change, Communication, and Enablement

• Manage efforts for stakeholder engagement, communications, and change management for AI initiatives, supporting training and capability-building across lifecycle teams.

• Build and maintain networks of AI champions and subject matter experts, promoting a culture of experimentation and responsible AI usage.

**You

**You have a relevant educational background within business, data science, technology, or a similar field. In addition, you have a good understanding of business processes, operating models, and digital transformation, and 5+ years of experience working with technology transformation, AI, data, automation, or similar initiatives, with the ability to translate business challenges into practical AI opportunities and outcomes.

We look for the following in a candidate:

• Good stakeholder management and communication skills, comfortable translating between business and technology audiences to turn emerging AI capabilities into practical business value.

• Experience driving change, adoption, and organizational enablement initiatives.

• Ability to manage multiple initiatives and priorities in a dynamic environment.

• Curious, business-oriented, and outcome-focused.

• Combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and is motivated by delivering measurable impact through technology-enabled change.

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

**CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

**CIP Fund Solutions

**CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.

Help grow Awaze’s commercial footprint across Germany, Austria and Switzerland by building high-performing travel agency relationships and strategic partnerships that bring our holidays to even more guests.

**Your mission

**As our new Senior Partnership Account Manager, your mission is to grow Awaze’s commercial footprint across the DACH region through two interconnected areas: developing our travel agency channel and building strategic commercial partnerships.

As you’ll be working directly with travel agencies and partners across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, you’ll need to be fluent in German, at native or near-native level, as well as confident communicating professionally in English.

You’ll own and grow relationships with travel agencies across the region, lead agencies through the transition from legacy booking systems to Awaze’s modern platform, and identify new opportunities to expand our network. Alongside this, you’ll develop strategic partnerships from initial prospecting and negotiation through to onboarding and ongoing account development.

Working closely with Marketing, Product, Commercial and leadership teams, you’ll use market insight and performance data to strengthen partner engagement, extend Awaze’s reach and deliver measurable commercial impact.

**What You'll Be Doing

**

• Own and develop relationships with travel agencies across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, with a particular focus on chains and networks.

• Lead the end-to-end transition of agencies from legacy booking systems to Awaze’s modern platform, including change management, training and onboarding.

• Identify, develop and onboard new travel agency partners, maintaining a strong pipeline of prospective agencies.

• Proactively identify, pursue, negotiate and close new strategic commercial partnerships across the DACH region.

• Manage the full partnership lifecycle, from initial outreach and commercial negotiation through to onboarding and ongoing account development.

• Monitor agency and partnership performance, using data and commercial metrics to identify opportunities for increased adoption, engagement and growth.

• Collaborate with Marketing, Product and Commercial teams to ensure partners are effectively supported and positioned for success.

• Identify co-marketing and co-branding opportunities that create mutual value and extend Awaze’s reach and brand presence.

• Act as a source of DACH market intelligence, sharing relevant trends, partner feedback and commercial insights with leadership and product teams.

• Travel regularly across the DACH region to build and strengthen relationships with agencies and strategic partners.

**Who We’re Looking For

**You’ll thrive in this role if you’re a natural relationship builder who enjoys turning commercial opportunities into long-term, mutually valuable partnerships. You’re comfortable taking ownership of a varied portfolio, confident working independently and equally at home discussing performance data, negotiating a new partnership or helping an established agency embrace a new way of working.

Fluent German, at native or near-native level, is an essential requirement for this role. You’ll use German regularly to build trusted relationships and communicate effectively with travel agencies and strategic partners across the DACH region.

**We’re Looking For Someone Who Brings

**

• Several years of experience in account management, partnerships or business development, ideally within travel, hospitality or a related sector.

• A demonstrable track record of growing accounts and closing partnerships that deliver measurable commercial outcomes.

• Fluent German, at native or near-native level, alongside strong professional English, both written and spoken.

• Strong relationship-building, communication and presentation skills, with the credibility to engage agency owners, commercial partners and senior stakeholders.

• Strong analytical capabilities and confidence using performance data and commercial metrics to inform decisions and identify opportunities.

• An understanding of brand and marketing principles and the ability to represent Awaze consistently with external partners.

• A self-motivated and structured approach, with the ability to independently manage a large and varied account portfolio.

• Willingness and ability to travel regularly across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, as well as other locations when required.

• Bonus points if you have experience within the DACH travel agency landscape, legacy travel booking systems or digital platform transitions, or have worked within or alongside a major European travel group.

• An established network across DACH travel agencies or hospitality chains, or experience with GDS tools and partnership management platforms, would also be an advantage.

**How You'll Make An Impact

**

• Successfully transition and onboard travel agencies onto Awaze’s modern platform, driving strong adoption and engagement.

• Grow the number, quality and performance of active travel agency relationships across the DACH region.

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective agencies and strategic partners, progressing opportunities through to successful commercial agreements.

• Strengthen retention, satisfaction and commercial performance across your agency and partnership portfolio.

• Turn performance data into clear insights and recommendations that help both our partners and internal teams make better commercial decisions.

• Work across Marketing, Product and Commercial teams to unlock partner support, co-marketing opportunities and additional commercial value.

• Bring relevant DACH market trends, partner feedback and insights into Awaze to help inform product and business decisions.

• Champion Awaze’s brands and standards across every agency and partner interaction.

**Why you’ll want to work at Awaze

**We offer a versatile position in a strong professional and social environment - one you’ll have the opportunity to influence and help shape. You’ll be part of an international company that invests in the future, and join a dynamic, fast-paced department with skilled and committed colleagues who support each other.

We’re a People-first Business - And We Know That Our Success Starts With Our Teams. Here’s a Glimpse Of What You’ll Enjoy

• Generous discounts on holidays across our brands

• Flexible hybrid working – with the autonomy to work how you work best

• Real opportunities to grow, learn and shape your role as well as careers progression vertically or horizontally, cross countries and responsibilities.

**About Awaze

**Our mission is clear - to create amazing holidays with Europe’s widest choice of holiday homes.

With more than 110,000 properties across Europe, we are the largest managed vacation rentals business in the region. Our ambition is not only to be the biggest, but the best provider of holiday homes in Europe.

As travel continues to evolve, we are focused on what comes next. We will keep strengthening our relationships with guests and homeowners, continuously improving the way we work, and delivering strong performance. By making things simpler and smarter, we are building a business that is ready for what’s next - powered by proud, passionate and inclusive people.

**Worth knowing

**

• This role can be based remotely in Germany or from our Virum office in Denmark.

• Regular travel across Germany, Austria and Switzerland will be an important part of the role, with travel to other locations when required.

**What’s next?

**If this sounds like the right next step for you, hit “Apply” and follow the instructions to submit your application. We tailor our recruitment process to each role to give both you and our hiring teams the best possible chance to assess whether this could be the start of a successful collaboration. You’ll hear from us shortly after we’ve reviewed your application.

We’re committed to running an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment, and if you have any specific requirements or adjustments needed for the interview, just let us know when you accept your invitation - we’re happy to accommodate.
